/*selectMasterWmGrWarehousingNoPopList_1*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, --[00] DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','') DOC_TEXT, --[01] (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, --[02] (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, --[03] H.PO_NO AS PO_NO, --[04] H.PURCHASER_NAME AS PO_USER_NAME, --[05] (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = H.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, --[06] H.PO_CREATE_DATE, --[07] H.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT AS AGENT_AMT, --[08] H.PO_TTL_AMT AS PO_AMT, --[09] H.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY, --[10] H.PO_REMARK AS REMARK, --[11] H.DOC_TYPE, --[12] H.BUYER, --[13] R.PURCHASER_DEPT, --[14] R.REQ_DEPT, --[15] H.PURCHASER_ID, --[16] R.REQ_USER_ID, --[17] DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0','직납','1','재고','2','T/R','3','VMI') AS 납품유형, --[18] D.RD_DATE, --[19] D.PO_SEQ, --[20] (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME --[21]
, V.PARCEL_COM_CODE PARCEL_COM_CODE --택배회사 코드 , C.COM_NAME PARCEL_COM_NAME --택배회사 명 , V.PARCEL_INV_NO PARCEL_INV_NO --택배송장 번호 , REPLACE(C.INV_NO_URL,'param', V.PARCEL_INV_NO) REAL_INV_NO_URL -- 택배사_매핑 경로
FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPODT D, ICOMPRDT R , ( SELECT DECODE(Z.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', W.DELIVERY_COMPANY , Y.PARCEL_COM_CODE ) PARCEL_COM_CODE , DECODE(Z.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', W.DELIVERY_NO , Y.PARCEL_INV_NO ) PARCEL_INV_NO , X.BUYER , X.PO_NO , X.PO_SEQ FROM ICOMIVDT X , ICOMIVHD Y , ICOMPOHD Z , WMSIVDT W WHERE 1=1 AND X.BUYER = Y.BUYER AND X.INV_NO= Y.INV_NO AND X.BUYER = Z.BUYER AND X.PO_NO = Z.PO_NO AND X.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND X.INV_NO= W.S_INV_NO(+) AND X.INV_SEQ= W.S_INV_SEQ(+) AND X.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND X.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND X.PO_SEQ= #{st_po_seq} AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND Y.STATUS <> 'D' AND NVL(W.STATUS, '-') <> 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) V , (SELECT CODE COM_CODE , TEXT2 COM_NAME , TEXT5 INV_NO_URL FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' ) C WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ
AND D.BUYER = V.BUYER(+) AND D.PO_NO = V.PO_NO(+) AND D.PO_SEQ = V.PO_SEQ(+) AND V.PARCEL_COM_CODE = C.COM_CODE(+)
AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND R.STATUS <> 'D'

/*selectMasterWmGrWarehousingNoPopList_2*/ SELECT D.REF_PR_NO, --[00] D.DESCRIPTION, --[01] D.MAKER_NAME, --[02] P.ITEM_QTY, --[03] P.UNIT_MEASURE, --[04] D.UNIT_PRICE, --[05] D.DS_DATE, --[06] D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[07] D.SPECIFICATION, --[08] D.INV_QTY, --[09] NVL(D.INV_QTY,0) * D.UNIT_PRICE AS AGENT_SUM, --[10] D.INVOICE_DATE --[11] FROM ICOMIVDT D, ICOMPODT P WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND D.BUYER = P.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = P.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = P.PO_SEQ AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY D.INV_NO, D.INV_SEQ
